name: NuPhy Toolkit
short_description: Practical AI workflows for NuPhy teams.
long_description: NuPhy Toolkit is an extensible collection of focused AI workflows for NuPhy teams. Its first skill guides teammates through step-by-step requirement clarification, identifies missing context, separates facts from assumptions, and outputs a Feishu-ready requirement entry plus a lightweight PRD draft. The current release does not change code, publish content, write to Feishu, or decide final priority and engineering complexity.
countries_and_regions: Choose only regions supported by NuPhy legal and support teams in the submission portal.
